tool_description: Rivet SMS API offers programmable SMS APIs, so you can get maximum value from your messages. Use our APIs to send single, bulk messages , schedule broadcasts, configure/ triggers messages and much more.
name: Rivet SMS
title: Rivet SMS

api_list.name: Sent Message Status
api_list.description: Get the sent message status of the message using the message id.

required_parameters.name: ClientId
required_parameters.description: Use Rivet SMS API client Id(You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

required_parameters.name: ApiKey
required_parameters.description: Use Rivet SMS API API key (You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

required_parameters.name: MessageId
required_parameters.description: Id of the message for which you need its status.

api_list.name: Get Sender ID
api_list.description: Get the list of all Sender ID that are registered for your account to send SMS.

required_parameters.name: ClientId
required_parameters.description: You can get the Client ID at https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs, once your account is created.

required_parameters.name: ApiKey
required_parameters.description: You can get the API key at https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs, once your account is created.

api_list.name: Bulk SMS
api_list.description: Send bulk sms  to multiple numbers .

required_parameters.name: ApiKey
required_parameters.description: Use Rivet SMS API API key (You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

required_parameters.name: ClientId
required_parameters.description: Use Rivet SMS API client Id(You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

optional_parameters.name: Is_Flash
optional_parameters.description: Is_Flash is true or false for flash message

optional_parameters.name: ScheduleTime
optional_parameters.description: Date in yyyy-MM-dd HH:MM (only for schedule message)

optional_parameters.name: Is_Unicode
optional_parameters.description: Is_Unicode is true ,if the message is unicode message else  false for non-unicode message

test_endpoint.ErrorDescription: Message or mobile number cannot be blank

api_list.name: SendSMS

required_parameters.name: SenderId
required_parameters.description: Use  Rivet SMS  sender ID that is assigned to you (You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/Management/ManageSenderID)

required_parameters.name: ClientId
required_parameters.description: Use  Rivet SMS API client ID (You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

required_parameters.name: MobileNumbers
required_parameters.description: Recipient number –  numbers in format - 971 223344566(please enter mobile number with country code, without preceding 00 or +). Multiple recipients can be specified separated by commas.

required_parameters.name: Message
required_parameters.description: Write the content of your SMS

required_parameters.name: ApiKey
required_parameters.description: Use  Rivet SMS API API key (You can get it from https://app.rivet.solutions/ApiDocument/ApiDocs#)

optional_parameters.name: Is_Unicode
optional_parameters.description: Boolean value : Is_Unicode is true for unicode message else false.

optional_parameters.name: ScheduleTime
optional_parameters.description: Date in yyyy-MM-dd HH:MM (only for schedule message)

optional_parameters.name: GroupId
optional_parameters.description: Valid group-id of current user (only for group message otherwise leave empty string)

optional_parameters.name: Is_Flash
optional_parameters.description: Boolean value: True if flash message else false.
